name: synther-gmbh
description: Synther GmbH — Systems engineering, process optimization and data-driven decision making.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/build-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/build-feed.mjs

scripts.cf:db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
